name: cf-vat-gst
description: Use this Central African Republic VAT Guide for 2026 research on taxable businesses, registration, imported services, invoices, input credits and monthly declarations. It uses the signed 2024 replacement of the VAT chapter, the signed 2025 filing and exemption amendments, and the 2026 prior-payment exemption mechanism. Search triggers include TVA, NIU, VAT threshold, electronic commerce, reverse charge, prorata, export credit and refund. It expressly rejects the obsolete quarterly wording in the Ministry’s older code. This remains a partial draft: tariff classification, cash-payment limits, implementing orders, live forms and independent review are unresolved. No accountant has attested to these calculations.
